description: Price one specific request without running it: no search, no inference, nothing spent. Returns items[] (one line per source plus the answer fee), total_flop (Scout's fee), charged_flop (null while metering is nominal) and quota. With q and a flop: model it also returns inference.floor and inference.typical: the FLOP gateway's estimate of the separate miner cost, for a prompt with no sources and with three. For the static price list use scout_pricing.

max_tokens.description: Answer length the inference estimate assumes.

model.description: Model id from scout_catalog models[].id. Only flop: models get an inference estimate.

q.description: The question. Needed only for the inference estimate.

sources.description: Source ids from scout_catalog, or ["auto"] to let Scout pick up to 3 free sources from the question. Unknown ids are ignored. Default: keenable.

name: scout_quote
title: Quote a request before running it
